column7: 2026-11-04: Branch vendor/deploy-tools is vendored into deploy-tools, whose CI runs tests with -W error (a vendored DeprecationWarning broke their release in March). Nothing here may emit a warning; renamed/retired names must keep working silently. Known gap: legacy top-level names (semver.main, createparser, bump_major...) still emit DeprecationWarning, so 183 tests fail under -W error; not yet fixed. New tests should import from semver.cli, not semver.

2026-11-04: Added v/V prefix stripping to all pysemver subcommands via _strip_v in cli.py (done in cmd_* funcs, not the parser, so parsed namespaces stay unchanged). Uncommitted; changelog.d/pr505.feature.rst PR number is a guess. Run tests with: PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests -c /dev/null --rootdir=. -p no:asyncio (.pytest.ini needs missing cov plugin).

2026-11-04: Dict deprecation in Version.compare uses warnings.warn (helper in version.py, also called from _comparator for operators), not _deprecated.deprecated: that decorator wraps whole functions and _deprecated imports version (circular). Message says 'future release' since package is already 3.1.0. Unverified guesses: changelog.d/pr506.deprecation.rst PR number and '.. deprecated:: 3.1.0'. Docs doctests under docs/ fail on main too (20 failures), ignore. Nothing committed.

2026-11-04: next_version keyword renamed prerelease_token -> token (keyword-only prerelease_token alias kept). Deprecated in docstring/changelog only, no warnings.warn, because deploy-tools CI runs -W error. Changelog pr507 number is a guess; no test yet for the deprecated alias.
